# JS CodeLab — Complete LLM Resource Map

> JS CodeLab is a free, privacy-first in-browser JavaScript compiler, interactive playground, and developer certification platform. It evaluates JavaScript code locally in browser Web Workers without server roundtrips, accounts, or telemetry.

Website: https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app
Repository: https://github.com/sureshkumar9651/compiler
License: Open Source (MIT)

---

## 1. Core Architecture & Philosophy

JS CodeLab operates under a strictly local-first engineering philosophy:
1. **Isolated Client Execution**: Code is evaluated entirely inside browser-native Web Workers. No server containerization, no queuing delays, and zero network data transmission of user code.
2. **Offline-Capable Persistence**: User scripts, scratchpads, and project trees are stored locally on the client device using browser IndexedDB.
3. **Monaco Editor Integration**: Developers receive first-class VS Code editing features: syntax validation, TypeScript definitions, bracket matching, and format-on-save.
4. **Professional Certifications**: A 50-track technical assessment suite with randomized question order, strict anti-cheat event detection, and PDF certificates with verification IDs.

---

## 2. All Educational Guides & Tutorials (/learn)

- **Variables (let vs const)**: https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/learn/variables
  Declarations, immutability, reassignment rules, and why `var` is discouraged in modern ES6+ code.
- **JavaScript Functions**: https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/learn/functions
  Function declarations, expressions, arrow functions, implicit returns, and lexical scoping.
- **JavaScript Arrays**: https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/learn/arrays
  Array indexing, iteration patterns, and core transformation utilities (map, filter, reduce).
- **Promises & Async/Await**: https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/learn/promises
  Asynchronous execution, the microtask queue, Promise lifecycle (pending, fulfilled, rejected), and async/await syntax.
- **Understanding Closures**: https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/learn/closures
  Lexical environments, persistent state retention, encapsulation of private variables, and factory functions.
- **Array Map vs forEach**: https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/learn/map-vs-foreach
  Comparative analysis of transformation vs iteration, immutable array creation, and performance implications.
- **Destructuring**: https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/learn/destructuring
  Unpacking objects and arrays, default fallback values, and nested property extraction.
- **Spread & Rest Operators**: https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/learn/spread-rest
  Shallow cloning, array concatenation, variable argument gathering, and function parameter handling.
- **Template Literals**: https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/learn/template-literals
  Backtick strings, multiline strings, embedded expressions, and tagged template functions.
- **Scope & Hoisting**: https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/learn/scope-and-hoisting
  Global, function, and block scope hierarchies, variable hoisting mechanics, and the Temporal Dead Zone (TDZ).
- **Error Handling (try/catch)**: https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/learn/error-handling
  Runtime error management, throw statements, error objects, and finally blocks.
- **Array reduce() Method**: https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/learn/array-reduce
  Accumulator mechanics, grouping data, flattening arrays, and functional pipeline synthesis.
- **The 'this' Keyword**: https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/learn/this-keyword
  Dynamic invocation context, explicit binding (call, apply, bind), and arrow function lexical this.
- **JavaScript Objects**: https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/learn/objects
  Key-value structures, object methods, property accessors, prototype inheritance, and Object utilities.

## 4. Technology Certification Domains (/certifications)

1. **Programming Languages**: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java 21, Go, C# 12, C++20/23, PHP 8+.
2. **Frontend Engineering**: React.js, Next.js, HTML5, CSS3, Web Performance, Tailwind CSS, Web Accessibility (WCAG 2.2).
3. **Backend Engineering**: Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, Auth/Identity (OAuth2/OIDC), GraphQL Architecture, API Security.
4. **Databases**: SQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, MySQL, Database Design & Optimization.
5. **DevOps & Cloud**: Docker, Git, Kubernetes, Linux Administration, CI/CD Pipelines, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform.
6. **Testing & Software Quality**: Jest, Playwright, Vitest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Unit Testing Architecture, Integration/E2E Testing.
7. **Architecture & Computer Science**: Distributed System Design, Data Structures & Algorithms, Cybersecurity Fundamentals, Design Patterns, Generative AI Fundamentals, Clean Code & Refactoring, Object-Oriented Programming, Machine Learning Fundamentals.
